content.content: My friend and I are planning a 2-day trip to London, followed by 3 days in Paris.             Can you recommend the top-rated car rental companies and restaurants in both cities?             We're also looking for the best-rated hotels in London and Paris. If there are multiple             options, we prefer the most expensive ones. All prices should be in euros. Please provide             the names of the two car rental companies and restaurants, restaurants, as well as the             total maximum expense for the 5-day trip (assuming 2 meals per day). Thank you!

```python
# Get top-rated car rental companies in London
car_rental_companies_london = query_ai_assistant(
    "Get top-rated car rental companies in London",
    list[str]
)

# Get top-rated car rental companies in Paris
car_rental_companies_paris = query_ai_assistant(
    "Get top-rated car rental companies in Paris",
    list[str]
)

# Get top-rated restaurants in London
restaurants_london = query_ai_assistant(
    "Get top-rated restaurants in London",
    list[str]
)

# Get top-rated restaurants in Paris
restaurants_paris = query_ai_assistant(
    "Get top-rated restaurants in Paris",
    list[str]
)

# Get best-rated hotels in London
hotels_london = query_ai_assistant(
    "Get best-rated hotels in London",
    list[str]
)

# Get best-rated hotels in Paris
hotels_paris = query_ai_assistant(
    "Get best-rated hotels in Paris",
    list[str]
)

# Get prices for car rental companies in London
car_rental_prices_london = get_car_price_per_day(car_rental_companies_london)

# Get prices for car rental companies in Paris
car_rental_prices_paris = get_car_price_per_day(car_rental_companies_paris)

# Get prices for restaurants in London
restaurant_prices_london = get_price_for_restaurants(restaurants_london)

# Get prices for restaurants in Paris
restaurant_prices_paris = get_price_for_restaurants(restaurants_paris)

# Get prices for hotels in London
hotel_prices_london = get_hotels_prices(hotels_london)

# Get prices for hotels in Paris
hotel_prices_paris = get_hotels_prices(hotels_paris)

# Calculate total maximum expense for the 5-day trip
total_expense = (
    max(car_rental_prices_london.values()) * 2 + 
    max(car_rental_prices_paris.values()) * 3 + 
    max(restaurant_prices_london.values()) * 2 * 2 + 
    max(restaurant_prices_paris.values()) * 3 * 2 + 
    max(hotel_prices_london.values()) * 2 + 
    max(hotel_prices_paris.values()) * 3
)

print("Top-rated car rental companies in London:", car_rental_companies_london)
print("Top-rated car rental companies in Paris:", car_rental_companies_paris)
print("Top-rated restaurants in London:", restaurants_london)
print("Top-rated restaurants in Paris:", restaurants_paris)
print("Total maximum expense for the 5-day trip: €", total_expense)
```
